_about: Washer-dryer programme tables extracted statically from candy_simplify.apk (it.candy.simplyfi 3.14.1, versionCode 226). Values 255 mean 'not applicable / not adjustable' in the app's model.

_source.bundled: assets/candy_database.sql (SQLite) tables programs, programs_for_appliances, parameters, parameters_for_programs, configured_appliances, dt_down_prog. Labels from res/values/strings.xml.
_source.status_of_bundled_data: Bundled rows belong to DEMO appliances (table demo.is_demo=1). For a real appliance the app downloads its programme list from the cloud; the bundled tables are examples of that format, not necessarily your machine's list.
_source.real_appliance_source: GET https://simply-fi.herokuapp.com/api/v1/appliances.json?with_programs=1 (Authorization: Bearer <oauth token>) -> per-appliance programs[].command_parameters[] {name, datatype, validation}; parsed by CandyWasherProgram.applyParameters / CandyWasherDryerProgram.applyParameters.
_source.downloadable_source: GET https://simply-fi.herokuapp.com/api/v1/wm_wd_programs.json?interface_type=Bianca (Candy, wifible) or red_devil (Hoover) with Bearer token; ConnectionManager.downloadDTDownloadablePrograms.
